The core-core index, which strips out fresh food and fuel and is the BOJ's preferred gauge of trend inflation, rose 2.0% y/y, up from 1.8% in July.

The data is treated as a leading indicator for nationwide price trends and will factor into the BOJ's September 17-18 policy meeting.
